changes.title: Stargazing witches
items: When a soundsystem falls, its party witch stays and lies down out past the speakers to stargaze, in pairs and threes
When the party is over, all the party witches lie looking up at the sky; keep still beside one and she will get up to chat, hold hands, hug and stargaze with you

changes.title: Hex sigils
items: Sigils snap to a hex grid: press on a taken cell to pick that one up, never a fizzle
Parked animals rest 5 m above their sigil, not 10

changes.title: Babies
items: Leashed babies follow you in single file along your path on the ground, and scatter for the whole of a fight: as soon as something comes for you, until it's been quiet for a few seconds
Babies left far behind catch up with you in seconds, and their leashes aren't drawn
A baby only eats a berry when you put its sigil down within 10 m of one (those berries glow brightly while a baby's sigil is next to go down), and one berry makes it a youth
Eight babies are free to carry on the ground and in the treetops, whatever their kind
